reviews.title: Better than the ad looks
reviews.text:
Whenever I can’t sleep and don’t want to word puzzle this game is my go-to relaxer!! You don’t get bombarded with ads and the actions are smooth when dragging the puzzle around. I don’t like the white on yellow view, not enough contrast and causes some pretty bad eye strain, but if I get a yellow puzzle I just close the app and when I open it again I’m right back on my puzzle with a different color! Easy and no dashboard to navigate through - you’re just instantly right where you left off. 
If I could only k3 games on my phone ever again this would make the 2nd spot for sure.

reviews.title: Google Runs 2-Minute Long Ads Constantly
reviews.text:
Update: Sept 3, 2025. Google is now running two-minute-long ads, with no escape button. Trying to finish a level in less than 30 minutes is almost impossible. The ads include Google Chrome, Vita Mahjong, Hexa something, etc. I used to enjoy the game except for the constant ads.  

March 2025:
But twice in the last 48 hours the McDonalds ads have caused the app to freeze. I moved on to other games and checked back every few minutes to see when the game would reload. It takes several hours.
Update: it’s March 8, 2025, and the app is stuck on a McDonald’s ad again, this time en espanol. I’ve waited 5 minutes for it to go away. That’s ridiculous. Please fix this bug.
It’s March 11. Every time the McDonald’s breakfast ad in Spanish comes on, it crashes the game. Please pull the ad off your system.

Update: that bad McDonald’s ad is gone. Thank you. Now the biggest problem is the multiple 60-seconds ads that come on every time I ask for 50 more taps or ask for a whack from the whacker. A game can’t take more than 30 minutes!  One game! I’m pretty much going to move on unless you can stop with the 60s and go back to the 15s, and 30s.
7.12.25 Some of the offending ads with no escape button include Vita Mahjong, Jolly Mahjong, Vigor Mahjong, Spider Solitaire, solitaire.com, and Google Chrome. Please make these annoying 60 sec ad buyers insert escape buttons.

reviews.title: Deleted
reviews.text:
I love the game at first, but the constant interruptions from that gold floating box ruined the game for me. Based on other reviews, many others feel the same. I paid to remove ads, but the developer still found a way to interrupt the game by making you tap the gold box multiple times during every game, which stops the game, then makes you wait for animated graphics to end, then wait for the option to decline watching an ad for more coins/points (even though I paid extra to not watch ads), then finally back to the game. Oh good, another gold box a few moves later, wait for the animated graphics to end, wait for the option to decline watching an ad for more coins/points (again, I paid to not have to watch ads), then finally back to the game. Oh, another gold box,…and so on, and so on, and so on. What started as a relaxing game that I enjoyed, became frustrating and annoying, so I finally deleted it. 

Note to the developer: please don’t respond with the same “Thanks for your review. We will forward your review to our product team and try our best to improve your valuable gaming time”. If you genuinely wanted to “improve our valuable gaming time,” you would remove this annoying and intrusive feature. There are more effective ways to make ad revenue that don’t cause users to delete the game.

reviews.title: Fun, even with ads
reviews.text: Even playing for free and having to “watch” the ads, I am enjoying this game.  I challenge myself to strategically eliminate all of the blocks and still have moves left.  However, it would be nice if the developers would let those unused moves accumulate in an account to be used for future games when one really needs additional moves.  Then instead of watching ANOTHER video to earn those additional moves, one could draw on the previously unused, “banked” moves.  After all, those unused moves were granted to us but we didn’t use them.  If this change was implemented, I would give the game five stars.
